spotlights.headline: Eye surgeon who serves through their profession (sample)

spotlights.headline: Textile trader who serves through their profession (sample)
spotlights.story: Pankaj Goel is a textile trader from Aligarh. Wholesale cloth merchant who donates uniforms for school children every year. This is a sample spotlight story; the moderators will choose and write the real one each month.
